topic: the ideate-solo framing log for the jev-orchestrator build: design variations generated for the Jev v2 gated-approval orchestrator, the scoring and selection process, and the finalist design decisions

subtopics.scope: How the 7 design variations were generated by applying named ideation lenses (simplification, constraint removal, inversion, audience shift, combination) to the Jev v2 control diagram.
seed_queries: lateral thinking prompts generating engineering design alternatives SCAMPER
ideation methods constraint removal inversion audience shift design variations

subtopics.scope: The P/S/D/T scoring rubric, raw variation totals, the threshold cut, and which variations were dropped and why.
seed_queries: weighted decision matrix evaluating design alternatives scoring criteria
Pugh concept selection method scoring threshold dropping weak alternatives

subtopics.scope: Merging the two top-scored finalists (thin controller + ledger conventions) into one hybrid, and folding a third variation in as a compatibility constraint.
seed_queries: synthesizing multiple design concepts into one hybrid solution
combining complementary design alternatives rather than winner takes all

subtopics.scope: Why the execution gate must be deterministic and fail closed, and why LLM probabilities are advisory and never authorize actions.
seed_queries: fail closed security design principle authorization gate
LLM agent tool use deterministic policy engine guardrails authorization

subtopics.scope: The append-only outcomes-ledger pattern the design borrows: audit rows, digest-stable IDs, explicit verdicts, idempotency keys for action dispatch.
seed_queries: append only event log audit trail system design
idempotency keys exactly once action execution distributed systems

subtopics.scope: Hosting the state machine, gate, approval queue, and dashboard on a single Cloudflare Worker with D1 tables and KV policy docs.
seed_queries: Cloudflare Workers D1 database state machine workflow architecture
thin controller orchestration service minimal state machine persistence

subtopics.scope: The approval flow: pending approvals, dashboard as the queue, review-then-continue lifecycle, pause endpoint.
seed_queries: human in the loop approval workflow automation design patterns
approval queue dashboard design review then continue automation

subtopics.scope: Designing the /api/jev/* surface so n8n workflows and agent sessions are first-class callers: plain JSON, one task per resource, poll-friendly status, webhook-free.
seed_queries: REST API design for workflow automation polling instead of webhooks
n8n HTTP request node API integration best practices

subtopics.scope: What v1 deliberately excludes (tenants, learnings auto-activation, provider adapters, notifications) and how explicit non-goals are recorded and kept additive.
seed_queries: MVP scoping explicit non-goals what we are not building
deferred features additive schema design future proofing

untestable assumptions product bets validation mitigation
